readout.summary: No track: not a top-7 vs bottom-7 game (on the readout list for its 28 score). Most previews back Boston at about -150 to -164 (roughly 59-62%): Doc's Sports, Bang The Book, BettorsInsider and Sports Interaction all take the Bruins, citing better goaltending and defense (2.62-2.65 goals against vs Winnipeg's 3.27), home ice and three days' rest against a Jets team that just flew east. BettorsInsider projects 4-2 Boston. The dissent is CappersPicks' AI model (2-0 Jets): Winnipeg is 8-1-1 in its last 10 and has a 23.3% power play against Boston's 79.5% penalty kill. Boston has won the last three meetings 16-7. Swayman vs Stuart Skinner (.887 this season) is expected but unconfirmed. Boston's James Hagens (back) remains out, practicing in a non-contact jersey.
